findings.text: blocking: the matched importer arms are not the done_when's population. The gate ran tests/test_crew_obligations.py (an importer) plus tests/test_staged_write_inventory.py (not an importer, it only names obligations.py as a path string), while the repository's own selector reckon/crew/landing_measure.py:235 importer_population returns 119 test files for the two changed modules reconcile/crew/obligations.py and reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py. So 1 of 119 importing files ran at either revision, and the run's manifest evidence_inputs claim that the arms 'run the population that imports reckon.crew.obligations' is false. The all_debug partition requirement is met (sacct: jobs 1311838 and 1311854 COMPLETED on all_debug), so this is the population half only, but the done_when asserts the importer population and it is unmeasured.

non-blocking: recovery_classification.py is modified (DELIVERED_REVIEW_PHASES and _review_pointer_delivered added) although the node's declared write_paths in dispatch-detail.json list only reckon/crew/obligations.py and tests/test_a_delivered_review_reads_as_awaiting_promotion.py; the coordinator's repair advice directed the reuse fix here, so the change is authorised in substance, but the run's declared scope and the manifest's orientation_write_paths do not include the file, so the record understates what the gained commits touch.
